commit.message:
[hat] Fix constant expressions codegen for literals

In the code model, the following expression:

```
HATMath.maxf(input.array(idx), 1e-5f);
```
maps to this:

```
%10 : java.type:"float" = constant @loc="48:63" @1.0E-5f;
%11 : java.type:"float" = invoke %9 %10 @java.ref:"hat.HATMath::maxf(float, float):float"
```

In HAT, the code generator goes to literal construct, which emits
directly the value. However, if it is a constant float, we need to
append the "f" character too. This patch fixes this.
